status: Frozen before training outcome analysis; no models in Phase 5
split_algorithm: Within treatment_flg, sort by SHA256(seed:treatment_flg:client_id), break digest ties by client_id. First floor(0.6*n) train; through floor(0.8*n) validation; remainder final_test.
phase5_analysis_population: train only; retain all training customers regardless of demographic validity
primary_estimand: Unadjusted treatment minus control difference in probability of target=1 in the experimental customer population; causal interpretation conditional on assignment and measurement assumptions
confidence_interval: 95% Newcombe difference interval combining independent Wilson score intervals without continuity correction
hypothesis_test: Two-sided pooled two-proportion z test of equal purchase probabilities; alpha=0.05
sample_ratio_check: Two-sided exact binomial test against assumed allocation probability 0.5; protocol ratio unavailable. Full assignment metadata and training counts only. Training ratio is constrained by treatment-stratified splitting, so training check is not an independent randomization diagnostic.
holdout_rule: Audit structural validity without reporting validation/final-test target summaries. No holdout rates, effects, subgroup analysis, predictions, or policy selection. Raw labels remain locally accessible, so this is a procedural seal, not encryption.
scope: Audit, training ATE and feature recommendations only; no model fitting or purchases-wide download
